_about: Produce: 20 branded items. Official brand packshots (brand sites/CDNs only). Residue picture = USDA PDP crop-level (disclosed on every card as not brand-specific); nutrition = FoodData Central. Deterministic score, formula in each rationale. No EWG. Import: POST /api/admin/catalog/products/bulk {products, update_existing:true, require_packshot:true}. Built 2026-09-18.
